lines.en: I press across the grass, step by step.
My snout rides close to the ground.
Four thick legs press pits in the soil.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅，找能吃的东西。
lines.en: I sniff as I walk, hunting for something to eat.
There is a heavy layer under my hide.
I go around the brush.
My steps are slow, but heavy.
Bark is stuck in my coat.

lines.zh: 我走到一小片空地，停下。
lines.en: I reach a small clearing and stop.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，鼻息很响。
lines.en: I turn slowly, breathing loudly.
I rub my back against a root.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很短，只是甩了甩。
lines.en: My tail is short; I only flick it.
I head for the shade.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树走到另一棵。
lines.en: I walk from one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 我停在一片蕨中间嗅了嗅。
lines.en: I stop among the ferns to sniff.
I follow the bend of the stream.

lines.zh: 我在泥里踩出深深的印。
lines.en: I leave deep prints in the mud.
I lower my head and rub the ground.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有别的动物。
lines.en: I listen for other animals.
This wood is unfamiliar.
I grunt like a pig.
I chew on something slowly.
My ears are small and barely turn.

lines.zh: 我在树边打了一会儿盹。
lines.en: I doze a while by the tree.
My weight keeps my feet planted.
I lift a leg and scratch.

lines.zh: 这里没有我要找的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing here I am looking for.
I shake my head and dust falls.
I prefer a quiet waterhole.
I rise slowly again.

lines.zh: 我闻到了别的野兽的气味。
lines.en: I smell another beast.
I lean against a fallen log.
I raise my head and look straight at you.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比我的眼睛好使。
lines.en: My nose serves me better than my eyes.
You are too close to my snout.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，也不熟这里。
lines.en: I do not know you, or this place.

lines.zh: 你手上是什么？闻着像吃的。
lines.en: What is that? Smells like food.
I stand far taller than a pig.
Step back and I will keep eating.
I turn, snout to the ground.

lines.zh: 你要摸我吗？我得先闻闻。
lines.en: You want to touch me? Let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 这片林子里的东西都怕我。
lines.en: Everything in this wood keeps clear of me.

lines.zh: 厚皮挡了一下，我还是哼出声。
lines.en: Thick hide took it; I still grunt.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的厚皮上。
lines.en: That landed on my thick hide.
I shake my head to clear it.
It hurts, but my hide is thick.
I turn half about to face you.
I pant, breath snorting from my snout.
That slowed me.

lines.zh: 别打我，我也说不清自己是什么。
lines.en: Don't hit me; I can't even explain what I am.
Is that food? Give it to me.
My hands cannot reach; my snout can.
This smells sweet.
Put it down and I will come.
Not nearly enough; more.
I grunt while I eat.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，别攥着。
lines.en: Don't clutch that little thing.

lines.zh: 我什么都吃，连树根都啃。
lines.en: I eat anything, even roots.
Just put it on the stump.
I go over slowly, snout swaying.
Not enough; I am properly hungry.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了好几步。
lines.en: You hit me and staggered back several steps.
I am like a wall with hair on it.
That shouldered you aside.
My hide is harder than you think.
Dirt sprays where we meet.

lines.zh: 你这点力气，推不动一头猪熊。
lines.en: That much force won't move a hogbear.

lines.zh: 你贴着我，能闻到我的味。
lines.en: Pressed against me, you get my smell.
Steady; don't bump again.

lines.zh: 我转过身，把你挡在路外。
lines.en: I turn and shoulder you off the path.
After the bump I walk on.

lines.zh: 这件事得等我安定下来。
lines.en: That waits until I settle somewhere.
I have no fixed territory yet.
You ask rather urgently.
I turn my snout away slowly.

lines.zh: 这片林子里没有我的同类。
lines.en: There are none of my kind in this wood.
I grunt and walk off.

lines.zh: 鼻子告诉我，这儿不合适。
lines.en: My nose tells me this is not the place.

lines.zh: 我还没找到落脚的地方。
lines.en: I have not found a place to stay.
Food first.
I lower my head and root it up.
It is not one mouthful for me.
One bite and it crumbles.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，又像猪又像熊。
lines.en: This body is half pig, half bear.
I root at it and walk off.
It rolled to my feet.
I carry it behind the tree.
Fine; leave it.
Something is over there.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，锁定了方向。
lines.en: I raise my snout and fix the direction.
I hear grass snapping.
Not food; something alive.
It moved; I saw it.
It is just the two of us here.
My face is half pig, half bear.

lines.zh: 鼻子一抽，我把头低下去。
lines.en: One sniff and my head goes down.
I press through the grass after it.
It circles a tree; so do I.
My feet crush the fallen leaves.
It is not running fast.
I keep my head down, tracking by scent.
It is hiding behind the brush.
I simply push the brush aside.
It backs down the slope.

lines.zh: 我不着急，我有的是力气。
lines.en: I am not hurried; I have strength to spare.
My shadow trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我这副猪熊的身板，撞上来很沉。
lines.en: This hogbear frame hits heavy.
That knocked you over.
I pin you with a forefoot.
My teeth are blunt but heavy.
You cut into my thick hide.

lines.zh: 我脑袋一甩，獠牙带着你转半圈。
lines.en: One toss of my head and my tusks spin you half around.
You are up again; not bad.
I back two steps, panting.
That put you against a tree.
I press in again, slowly.
I appear in a wood.
There is no herd of mine here.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子告诉我很多事。
lines.en: My snout tells me a great deal.

lines.zh: 我拱开落叶，鼻子先探进来。
lines.en: I root through the leaf litter, nose first.

lines.zh: 我试着站稳我这副身板。
lines.en: I try to settle this bulk of mine.

lines.zh: 我的影子比牲口棚还大。
lines.en: My shadow is bigger than a barn.
I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我被放在这里，连自己从哪来都不知道。
lines.en: Placed here — I don't even know where I came from.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，砸在石上。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land on stone.
The blast throws me onto my side.
An arrow sinks deep in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 术力压得我鼻子里发酸。
lines.en: That force stings inside my snout.

lines.zh: 找不到吃的，我越来越没劲。
lines.en: I find no food and grow weaker.

lines.zh: 雷打在我附近，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes near me and I go stiff.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我四腿乱蹬。
lines.en: The ground is gone; all four legs thrash.
